meta.name: Quantum · memory coefficient ≤ 1/2
meta.regime: Constant Bernoulli noise; limiting memory coefficient ≤1/2 on the n/log₂n scale
meta.rules: Compare the leading time coefficient at the stated subexponential memory cap. The c-sum methods use the Independence Heuristic; tailored rows additionally require the Tailoring Heuristic. Every fixed positive exponent slack is allowed. Quantum rows assume coherent indexed access to the stored list.
